quote: No person shall ride or drive any horse or vehicle over or across any pavement newly laid or repaired across or around which there has been placed a barrier, or at or near which there is a person or a sign warning persons against riding or driving over such pavement, or a sign stating that the highway is closed. The provisions of this Section shall not apply to the employees actually engaged in the paving or repair of such pavement.

activation.condition: Person rides or drives a vehicle over or across newly laid or repaired pavement protected by a barrier, warning person or sign, or closed-highway sign.

obligation.description: Do not ride or drive over or across such pavement.

exceptions.trigger: Employee actually engaged in paving or repair of that same pavement
exceptions.source_clause: The provisions of this Section shall not apply to the employees actually engaged in the paving or repair of such pavement.

timing.description: Protection placed before vehicle passage; employee work concurrent with passage.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Warning location relative to protected pavement is preserved for review without an invented legal distance.
Same-pavement active work and driver employment require source and timing review.

parameter_refs.name: protection_kind
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: barrier across/around, warning person/sign or closed-highway sign

parameter_refs.name: employee_engaged
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: driver is or is not an employee actively paving or repairing the same pavement
